theme_central: The unity and universality of divine revelation, the sole foundation of a just human community — one of whose concrete expressions is mutual consultation (shura), which gives the surah its name.
sources_note: Structure in 5 major parts sourced (iqna.ir), refined with known landmarks (shura at verse 38, the three modes of revelation in the closing 51-53).

branches.title: Opening, universal revelation
branches.resume: Revelation to Muhammad as to the previous prophets; the angels ask forgiveness for the inhabitants of the earth.

children.t: Universal revelation, the angels ask forgiveness for the inhabitants of the earth

branches.title: Arabic Qur'an, one single religion
branches.resume: Warning the Mother of Cities; the prescribed religion is one since Nuh; division arose out of jealousy.

children.t: Arabic Qur'an to warn; one single religion prescribed since Nuh
Division arose out of jealousy among people despite the clarity of the message

branches.title: Tilling for this world or the hereafter
branches.resume: Choice between the two harvests; promised reward; rain sent after despair.

children.t: Choice between tilling for this world or for the hereafter
The Prophet asks only for affection toward his relatives; rain sent after despair

branches.title: Misfortunes and deeds, signs of the ships
branches.resume: Misfortunes are a consequence of people's deeds; ships at sea as signs.

children.t: Misfortunes a consequence of deeds, ships at sea as signs

branches.title: The believers and mutual consultation (shura)
branches.resume: Heart of the surah: avoiding grave sins, forgiveness, mutual consultation, fair self-defense.

children.t: Avoiding grave sins, forgiveness, mutual consultation (shura)
Fair defense against injustice, patience and forgiveness preferable

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: No protector for whoever Allah leads astray, gifts of children according to divine will, three modes of revelation.

children.t: No protector for the misguided; gifts of children according to divine will
Three modes of revelation; the Qur'an, a light guiding to the straight path
